review_description: Quoting process was good as changes were requested and followed up promptly.Installation was good and took a day to complete but rushed towards the end without a thorough go through on how all things work. There were 5 sections of short conduits exposed on the roof which could have gone under the roof tiles, but I can live with it.Customer service was good up to the installation of system but seems to have tapered off as queries and request have not come back quickly for outstanding paperwork. This may be due to suppliers not getting back to them.They arranged for all Council, Building Surveyor and Hydro connection & sign offs which was great for me.Overall, I was happy with their performance and would recommend them to others.

I have already written a separate review on Google. Ben Castle came round for the quote and spent plenty of time with us explaining the system and answering our questions. We were impressed with his overall knowledge of solar installations and of electrical systems in general. He was very helpful and personable. Ben and his team did a great job of the installation which was carried out about a month after the quote. They were punctual, careful, tidy and very personable. Ben oranised the grid connection and all the necessary paperwork with Tasnetworks and the energy company. He came round several times to check on the completed job, to answer questions and to go through the monitoring apps with us. We are very happy with the installation and performance to date.

Well he double booked himself for the first consultation appointment and cancelled last minute but I gave him the benefit of the doubt and from there I had no complaints. Ben was professional, polite, friendly and very thorough and paid attention to every detail. He offered a lot of advice about hardware options and answered my email questions promptly. His team similarly were very pleasant to deal with and the installation was super tidy and they cleaned up everything around the site. We’ll go back to Castle for our future EV charger and any other energy works.Highly recommended.

Ben does both the sales quoting and the installation so you know you are dealing with the person who is going to do the work.  His system design was innovative and the least obtrusive aesthetically for our property. Our system is also within 50m of the ocean and Ben was able to address all the challenges associated with this with a very competitive price.  Ben also addresses any issues with the system in a timely fashion and delivers on what he says.  We'll definitely use him again to install a vehicle charger when we eventually get an EV.

We had several quotes through other installers. Ben as owner of the business attended the site and was very professional and friendly. During the site visit he checked the roof and building for installation location and any issues.Installation was completed over several days, the installation and workmanship quality is of a  very high standard.Ben was very helpful with a few changes made and went out of his way to answer all my questions. Connection to grid and all paperwork completed swiftly and promptly.Only issue post install was the inverter was not able to communicate to the internet. This was a result of our wifi router firewall and not a result of the install or inverter.

Ben from Castle Solar was punctual and well informed. From the prompt initial onsite inspection of the roof, through the option discussion phase, and then actual installation, all were done in the time frame he committed to in a manner that instilled confidence in his professionalism.Grid connection and provision of operating manuals and ‘use monitoring, app all provided on day following install

Ben Castle was prompt, professional, well organised and versed with the solar industry and the suite of products available.As the installer (rather than a salesperson) he spent time at the initial meeting doing an on-site assessment of the house and provided expert advice regarding installation of the panels and inverter.Within a few days he presented the appropriate quotes with three (and finally four) options available, and provided follow up advice and information as requested.Ben was always on time and professional in his approach and the work went smoothly.  There was a minimum of inconvenience and he was concerned to ensure that the completed work was neat and tidy.On completion of the installation we received appropriate contract documentation and advice on the grid connection process. We also received a link to the inverter website to be able to install the system performance monitoring app.Subsequently we have been able to observe what appears to be very satisfactory performance of our solar system and we would recommend Castle Solar Pty Ltd to anyone seeking a quotation and services regarding solar energy.
Very satisfied with all aspects of the process. Castle did all the paperwork and dealings with my energy supplier .

The whole process with Ben and his crew was very professional. Ben visited the site and we discussed location of inverters and any future batteries. He also advised on some changes to the meter box. Their work was very tidy and Techsafe the installation checkers for Tasmania said the work was A1 and I had a great job done. Work was scheduled and done to plan. I’m now looking at adding a battery or batteries.

We recently had Castle Solar & Electrical install our new solar system, we had multiple quotes from other companies but after talking with Ben we had to look no further, he was very professional with his site inspection and the time he took to explain the process, which made us feel very comfortable in choosing him to do the install.Ben & his team did a fantastic job, they were very neat & completed the installation in a timely manner, we were impressed with the installation.We highly recommend Ben & his team to anyone looking at installing a Solar system.

Took me a while to figure out what I wanted and Ben was very flexible, helpful and patient. Installation was on time and went smoothly. No mess left behind.4 stars for quality of system, because I couldn’t afford the “top quality” components but still went with tier one.4 stars for value only because I could have possibly gotten similar system from a larger company. Ultimately, felt uncomfortable with the other companies for one reason or another and was very comfortable and happy with Ben and his team.

Castle Solar was one of the three providers given to us via the Solar Quote process. Castle Solar was the first to get in contact and the first to complete a site visit. As Ben is the owner, installer and designer, he was able to answer all of the questions we had. He recommended that we use angle mounts for the panels, as our roof has a one degree pitch south facing. Having the angle mounts will provide better generation during winter, which is the time of the year we need the solar the most. We decided after we received the quote that we might install batteries in the future, Ben adjusted the quote for a Hybrid Inverter, so when we are ready, it will be an easier installation.Once we were happy, Ben did all of the paperwork and organised the installation, keeping us updated on the progress of the equipment deliveries. On the day of the installation, Ben and his team were very considerate of the noise and did a great job of the installation. As a person who appreciates the attention to detail in peoples work, the installation was done at a very high standard.I would highly recommend Castle Solar to anyone in Hobart wanting to install Solar, we will be giving them a call when we are ready for batteries.

Castle Solar was a fantastic choice! Ben was prompt, courteous and extremely helpful. He answered all my queries (and there were many, some bordering on nerdy). The suggestions he made were spot on and I can’t thank him and his team enough for the excellent install they carried out. His attention to detail was quite amazing actually, even with yours truly looking over his shoulder and still asking questions. He organised everything from go to whoa. All I had to do was install my solar app to check my usage.The best comment I can make about my install is “would I recommend him”? You betcha… and I will, as I have a friend who is considering solar.Thanks heaps Castle Solar!

Ben came to our house to discuss the options and had a look at the roof, the meter box, and a peek inside the roof space. Talking to the person who would actually be doing the installation gave me a high degree of confidence regarding the quality of the system installation. Ben provided options that suited what we were looking for, and was a pleasure to deal with through the whole process.During installation, Ben and his team were polite, tidy and punctual, and were willing to answer all of my questions. I really appreciated their attention to detail and also feedback on the ridge capping on my roof.They also coped well with adapting the layout slightly when one panel did not fit due to the rafter arrangement and had to be shifted to an adjacent section of the roof.System labeling and documentation look to be thorough and professional.

Good coms. Neat at Tidy. Quality gear. Great Price.Only fizzer is that the Fronius inverter is DoA although it appeared OK. Thats getting replaced tomorrow, so there might be an update to this review!

Ben Castle took on the challenge of providing solar to 3 units in our little block of 6. Ben was both professional and friendly. He met with us to discuss our requirements and provided  a quote with mulitple options in less than 24 hours. He was helpful, prompt and patient in clarifying our questions. Ben was clear in his communications. He was both efficient and precise with the installation resulting in a very neat and thorough job. He was very respectful of our property, taking care with the ascetics of all the wiring.The independent inspector also commented on the quality of the work. I would highly recommend Castle Solar.

Ben (owner and lead electrician) measured the roof and supplied me with a detailed quote, which I accepted. He arrived at the agreed date/time, installed a very neat system, completed the paperwork, uploaded the monitoring system etc. and explained everything fully at every stage. I'm very pleased with the system and the whole installation process.

I am absolutely thrilled with the solar installation done by Castle Solar! From start to finish, the experience was top-notch and hassle-free. The team was incredibly professional and knowledgeable, making the entire process seamless.Right from the initial consultation, Ben demonstrated his expertise by thoroughly assessing my energy needs and explaining the different options available. They patiently answered all my questions and addressed any concerns I had, helping me choose the perfect solar solution for my home.The installation itself was a breeze. Ben was punctual, efficient, and clearly knew his stuff. He worked diligently, ensuring that every panel was perfectly positioned for maximum sunlight exposure. The attention to detail was impressive, and it's evident that he takes pride in his work.I'm already seeing the benefits of the solar panels in a significant reduction in my energy bills. It's such a gratifying feeling to know that I'm contributing to a greener environment while also enjoying long-term savings.What truly sets Castle Solar apart is their exceptional customer service. They kept me updated throughout the installation process and followed up afterward to ensure everything was functioning as expected. Their dedication to customer satisfaction is truly commendable.I wholeheartedly recommend Castle Solar to anyone considering a solar installation. Their professionalism, expertise, and outstanding service make them the go-to choice for harnessing the power of the sun. Thank you, Castle Solar, for making this experience so positive and rewarding

Castle Solar was terrific. The quoting (even with all our follow up questions) , the pricing, the install and after sales checking were all without fuss, delay or concern. We consider our system delivers exactly as promised and represents great value. Very happy customers.
